milestone.title: mp init defaults — root AGENTS.md + abort on existing project

intent.outcome: mp init creates a root AGENTS.md pointer by default (so agents land in the right place) and aborts with a clear error when run on an already-initialized project unless --force is passed.

problem.description: Two mp init rough edges. (1) init does not create a root AGENTS.md by default, so an agent opening the repo has no entry point unless one is hand-authored. (2) running mp init on an already-initialized project silently re-generates files, which can clobber a customized plan. Split out of M52 because these are init-behavior changes, unrelated to the state-tracking discipline that M52 now owns.

in_scope: Change mp init default: create root AGENTS.md on every init with a short pointer ('This repository is managed with master-plan. Tasks, execution order and backlog are maintained with the mp binary. See ./master-plan/AGENTS.md')
Add --skip-root-agents flag to opt out of root AGENTS.md creation
Change mp init to abort with a clear error when plan.toml already exists, unless --force re-generates all files
out_of_scope: State-tracking discipline, validate-time W30, auto-close (those stay in M52)
Changes to the execution engine or autonomous mode
Init for non-default profiles beyond the AGENTS.md pointer

acceptance_criteria.description: mp init --profile full creates root AGENTS.md by default; --skip-root-agents skips it
acceptance_criteria.evidence: init creates root AGENTS.md by default; --skip-root-agents skips it; tested in init_root_agents tests

acceptance_criteria.description: mp init on an existing project (plan.toml present) aborts with a clear error unless --force is passed
acceptance_criteria.evidence: init on existing project aborts with clear error referencing already initialized + --force; --force re-initializes; tested in init_transactional tests

steps.action: Change mp init to create root AGENTS.md by default with a short pointer message. Add --skip-root-agents flag to opt out. Update templates/ROOT-AGENTS-SNIPPET.md.
steps.done_when: mp init creates root AGENTS.md by default; --skip-root-agents skips it; init_root_agents tests pass

steps.action: Change mp init to abort with a clear error when run on an already-initialized project (plan.toml exists), unless --force is passed which re-generates all files. Update commands/init.rs and store.rs.
steps.done_when: mp init on existing project aborts with clear error; --force re-initializes; init_transactional tests pass
